summary: Compass Minerals International filed an 8-K reporting that director David Safran delivered his resignation on October 9, 2026, which the Board accepted on October 14; the Board also voted to shrink its size to eight members. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or compensatory arrangement was disclosed, and no successor director was named. The abrupt board departure is itself the event under Item 5.02(b), with the board-size reduction as a structural follow-on. Watch for further director exits, any activist or strategic-review context, and whether an 8-K/A clarifies board composition.
